items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1961-10-11
items.q: He's a third corner player. My daddy's friend.

ctx.x: He's a third corner player. My daddy's friend. He was the third and the next to the last. The last man was Sam Morgan. Sam Morgan was the last.
I knew Bung White well when he came back.

items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: And Olympia. That was the Bunk Johnson.

ctx.x: From the first band on. Look, Papa had the Sapera band. He played with nobody. That was with Freddie Capit. Sapera. The Empire. The Empire. And Olympia. That was the Bunk Johnson. And the Olympia. The Bunk Johnson up on Rampart and Gradient.
That's all in there. You got it again? That's all in there.
